items.title_orig: Wolf Alice Show on Ellie's Birthday ... also Worldcup Final
items.article_text:
Wolf Alice play an Open-Air at "Arena Wien" on July 19th. And it's NOT sold out yet:
 oeticket.com
 Which is bothering me quite a bit - because it's also Ellie's birthday! That has to get sold out, I mean come on XD
 Now I was just checking sports news and realised - FIFA Worldcup Final is also July 19th... darn it.
 OF COURSE I'm gonna be at the concert, but this doesn't make it easier to get sold out.
 So - if you excuse the promo - if you want to boycott FIFA, or just need a convenient excuse to skip the final, or simply want to see Wolf Alice Open-Air on Ellie's Birthday in one of the coolest locations (which also happens to have 50th anniversary this year) - maybe book a trip to Vienna, just saying ;-)
 And anyone whose there and your national team plays at the final - which you will
